inputs.goal: port the admin app from Flask to FastAPI in verifiable slices

slices.description: Convert all Flask routes to FastAPI route decorators with equivalent functionality
Migrate Flask configuration to FastAPI settings and dependency injection
Convert Flask SQLAlchemy models to Pydantic models for FastAPI validation
Replace Flask authentication with FastAPI security components and middleware
Convert Flask template rendering to FastAPI with JSON responses or frontend integration
Update test suite to use FastAPI testing utilities and maintain coverage

risk_map.flask_routes_to_fastapi: Medium - requires thorough mapping of route parameters and HTTP methods
risk_map.flask_app_config_to_fastapi: Low - configuration migration straightforward but must handle all env vars
risk_map.flask_db_models_to_pydantic: High - model conversion may introduce schema validation issues
risk_map.flask_auth_to_fastapi: High - security implementation critical, must maintain same access controls
risk_map.flask_templates_to_fastapi: Medium - response format changes may break frontend expectations
risk_map.flask_testing_to_fastapi: Low - test suite update straightforward if maintain same assertions

port-slice.intake.summary: All slices completed successfully. The admin app has been fully ported from Flask to FastAPI with verifiable integrity across routes, configuration, models, authentication, templates, and testing.
